text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Kaori had resolved to board the ship and return to her hometown. With the day of departure drawing near, she kept coming to see {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
船に乗り、故郷へと帰る覚悟を決めたカオリ。
迫る出発の日を前に、{0}の元に
何度も足を運んでいた。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Haitaiii~♪ Good morning~sa!
Let's dance together again this morning~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハイタ～イ♪
おはようさ～、
今日も朝から
一緒に踊るさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
That's no good, you know?
We don't have much time left~!
Come on, wake up~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメだよ～？
時間は残り少ないからね～！
ほ
らほら、
起きて起きて～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Shall I help you get changed~?
Come on now, let's just whip those clothes right off~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
着替え、
手伝ってあげようか～？
ほらほら、
すぽぽーんと脱ぐさーっ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You don't need help?
Because you can take them off yourself?
Hmm, that's a shame~sa...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
手伝いはいい？
自分で脱げるから？
う～ん、
残念さ～……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Then I'll just dance here until you're done changing~sa♪
Ehh~? That's not okay either~? Are you feeling shy~?
You're such a tease~sa... I just want to spend as much time with you as I can, {0}~
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
着替えが終わるまで
ここで踊ってるさ～♪
ええ～、
それもダメ～？　
気になるの～？
いじわるさ～、
少しでも長く
{0}と一緒にいたいのに～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
That strange feeling I had the other day... I'm totally fine now~!
Was it because someone called me his lover?
Wait, I'm starting to feel all hot again... I need to calm down~!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この間感じた変な気持ち、
今はもう大丈夫だねー
あれはやっぱり恋人とか、
言われちゃったから？
って、
またなんか体が熱くなってきたさー
……
落ち着かなきゃー

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Ahaaa! Before we say goodbye, we've got to eat lots of delicious food, sing and dance to our hearts' content, and make sure we take plenty of memories back home with us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはー、
お別れの前に
いっぱいおいしいものを食べて、
たくさん楽しく歌って踊って、
思い出を故郷に
持って帰れるようにしなきゃね～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Look, even outside the Tee-da's shining so bright!
Wait, what? It's a little too bright~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
外のてぃーだも
こんなに輝いてるさ～！
って
あれ～？　
ちょっと明るすぎるさ～！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are~♪ Haitai!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
来た来た～♪
ハイターイ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for calling you out so suddenly.
It was so last-minute, I wasn't sure you'd even come~
text_block_list.orig_text:
急に呼び出しちゃってごめんねー
いきなりだったから、
来てくれないかもって思ってたよ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Umm, the reason I called you over... was because I wanted to see you before heading home, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと、
呼んだのはねー
帰る前に、
{0}と会っておきたかったからなんだよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Yeah. You know, today... I'm heading back to my hometown~sa.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
私ね、
今日……
故郷に帰るんさーねー

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: There aren't any karate tournaments for a while, so I don't know when I'll be able to come back~sa.
text_block_list.orig_text:
空手の大会はしばらくないし、
次に来れるのは
いつか分かんないんさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: And so... Before I left, your face suddenly came to mind~
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで、
帰る前になったら、
急に
{0}の顔を思い出してね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
If you're up for it, why don't we go explore the city together?
I want to take plenty of memories of this place back home with me~sa.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よかったらこれから、
私と一緒に
街を回ってみない～？
この街での思い出、
故郷にいっぱい
持って帰りたいからさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, sounds like you're up for it!
Then, together... Let's gooo~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
おお～
やる気だばーね！
じゃあ一緒に、
れっつご～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
First things first... gotta fuel up~sa!
You can't move the way you want to unless your stomach is satisfied, after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずはやっぱり、
腹ごしらえからさ～！
お腹を満足させないと
思うように
動けないからねー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... this place has nothing but fancy dishes.
Don't they have goya champuru~sa?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～……
このお店、
おしゃれなメニューばっかりだね～
ゴーヤーチャンプルーはないさ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's not a common dish?
Of course it is! Back home, well...
Not every single restaurant has it, but you can find it at most places~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
普通はない？　
そんなわけないさー！
私の故郷なら、
どこに行っても……
ってわけではないけど、
大体のお店にあるはずさー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
After filling up, some movement's in order~sa♪
The dance games here are really fun♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
満腹になった後は、
体を動かすさー♪
ここにあるダンスゲーム、
面白いんだよー♪

text_block_list.name: 香織
text_block_list.text:
ほら、
{0}も隣に立って！
一緒に踊るよー♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
{0}も隣に立って！
一緒に踊るよー♪

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, what's with that girl...? That's some incredible footwork...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
おいなんだあの子……
すげぇステップだぞ……！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: But that guy dancing with her... it looks like he's barely managing to keep up...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
あの一緒にやってる男の子は、
ついていくのがやっと
って感じね……！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aha~♪ I'm cranking up the difficulty even more~ You can keep up, right?~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～♪
もっと難易度を上げてくよ～、
ついてこれるよね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Phew... after a workout, maybe something sweet...
Wait, are you okay? You're completely out of breath!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ、
体を動かした後は、
甘いものでも食べて……
って、
大丈夫～？
息が絶え絶えさ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I think you might not be getting enough exercise.
Why don't you try joining a sports club or something~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
運動が足りないんじゃないかな～？
部活とか始めてみたら～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I recommend karate~! You've got sharp instincts, {0}, so I'm sure you'd pick it up in no time~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オススメは空手だよ～！
{0}は勘が鋭いから、
きっと
すぐ上達するさー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: And then maybe we'll end up facing each other at a karate tournament someday~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そしたら、
空手の大会とかで
私とぶつかることもあるかも～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that actually sounds pretty fun~♪ Come on, you should try karate with me~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわぁ、
それいいね～♪
ね、
空手やってみようさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Why are you looking away while you say that~sa?
Karate is fun, you know? Right~? I could teach you~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
むう。
なんで目をそらしながら言うさ～？
空手は楽しいよ～？　
ね～？
私が教えてあげるさ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, that's a nice straight punch!
Put a little more power into your hips like this, keep your elbows tucked in, and as for how you hold your fist...
Hm? Why are you pulling away~sa? Embarassed?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お～、
いい正拳突きだね～！
もう少しこうやって腰を入れて、
わきを締めて、
拳の握り方は～
ん？　
なんで離れるさ～？　
恥ずかしいの～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aha~♪ Please give it some serious thoughts~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～♪
本気で考えといてね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Pheeew... I had a great time~sa♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ～、
堪能したさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: That was REALLY fun~! Time flies when I'm with you, {0}~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
楽しかった～！
{0}といると
あっという間に時間が過ぎちゃうね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: If only we could have stayed together a little longer~sa...
text_block_list.orig_text:
できればもう少し、
一緒にいられれば良かったさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
My hometown is far away, you see...
So even if I want to come see you, I can't just drop by whenever I want~sa.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の故郷は遠いからね～
会いたいって思っても、
すぐには会えないんだよねー

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: ...I don't usually feel this way, but somehow, I'm suddenly getting lonely~sa...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
いつもは
そんなことないのに、
なんだか急に
寂しくなってきたさ～……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because I enjoyed being here?
No... most likely...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっちにいるのが
楽しかったからかな～？
ううん、
多分……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I'm feeling lonely... because we'll be separated, {0}... it's sad...
text_block_list.orig_text:
──{0}と離れるのが、
寂しいんだねー

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Aha~... it's not really like me, is it?
Usually, I'd just say "everything will work out~sa" and be fine...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～、
らしくないよね。
いつもは
なんくるないさ～
って言えば
平気なのに～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: But right now, I can't quite say it~sa...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今はあんまり、
言えないさー

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Really~sa?! You're actually coming all the way to my hometown?
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当さー！？
私の故郷まで
来てくれるのー！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! I'm so happy~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わーいっ！
でーじうれしいさー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: You know, hear up... there are so many places I want to show you, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのねあのね、
{0}にい～
っぱい見せたいところがあるんだよ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: The dazzling Tee-da, the sparkling sea, and all our historic buildings, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
眩しいてぃーだも、
キラキラ輝く海も、
歴史のある建物もね～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Let's look around at everything and sing and dance together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
色んなところを見ながら、
一緒に歌って踊ろうねー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: It'll DEFINITELY be fun! I guarantee it~sa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
絶対楽しいよー！
私が保証するさー！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I'll also treat you to some delicious food!
I'll keep cooking for you until you're absolutely stuffed♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいしいものも
私がご馳走するよー！
{0}のお腹がいっぱいになるまで、
作ってあげるねー♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: And then, after having a lot of fun...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでそれで、
いっぱい楽しんだ後は～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
We'll sit together and take our time gazing out at the sea, and just talk~
Sometimes, it's important to sit quietly and listen to the sound of the waves, too~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人でのんびり海を眺めて、
ゆっくりとお話しするさー
静かに波の音を聞く時間も、
大事だからねー♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Then it's a promise. I have no doubt you'll come to visit me~
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
約束だよ。
きっと
会いに来てね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aha~ It's such a great place, you won't even want to go home~sa...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～
帰りたくなくなっちゃうくらい、
いいところだからさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Oh, when you come to visit, you should lodge at my house~sa♪ You're always welcome there~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
その時は
私の家に住むといいさ～♪
{0}なら大歓迎だからね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Hm? You're hesitating? No need to hold back♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
それはちょっと？
遠慮なんていらないよー♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: To think I'd wake up every morning and find you there...
text_block_list.orig_text:
朝起きたら、
毎日
{0}がいてくれるなんてー……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: A-Ahaha~! Just imagining it... my face is starting to get hotter and hotter...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あは～！
想像してみたら、
なんか
顔がドンドン熱くなってきちゃったよ～……？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. We're both blushing bright red, aren't we~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
──えへへ。
お互い、
顔が
真っ赤だね～♪

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Home...
text_block_list.orig_text: 故郷……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good work.
Sorry, I was just lost in thought.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
お疲れさま。
ごめん、
ちょっと考え事してたわ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Kaori-chan is usually so full of energy, you'd think she never had a worry in the world, but I guess she gets lonely when she thinks about her hometown, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
普段は元気いっぱいで、
悩みごとなんて何もないって感じのカオリちゃんだけど、
故郷のことを思って
寂しくなったりもするのね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
No, I suppose that's only natural.
Everyone loves the place they've spent their lives in, after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
きっと当たり前のことよね。
誰でも、
自分の過ごしてきた場所は好きなはずだもの。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Someday, for sure... she'll be able to go back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
いつかきっと……
帰ることができるわ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Oops, I'm getting all sentimental, aren't I?
At times like this, there's that phrase Kaori-chan always says, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんて、
感傷的になっちゃったわね。
こういう時は、
カオリちゃんがよく口にしてるあの言葉よね？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Everything will work out~sa♪
text_block_list.orig_text: なんくるないさー♪

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Well then, bye bye♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃ、
バイバイ♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why am I sleeping in a bed~sa?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ～？
どうして私、
ベッドで寝てるさ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: And besides, this is your bed, isn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかも、
これって
{0}のベッドだよね～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I was sleeping on the floor when you woke up... So you carried me here~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
起きたら私が床で寝てたから、
運んでくれたの～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aha~♪ Sorry for stealing your bed, {0}~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あは～♪
ごめんねぇ、
{0}の寝るとこ、
取っちゃって～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I was planning to go out and have some fun with you today, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～ん、
今日は
{0}と一緒に
外に遊びに行こうと思ってたんだけど～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: It might be nice to just laze around indoors for a change~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
たまには室内で、
のんびりゴロゴロするのも
いいかもしれないね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Wanna sleep together, {0}?
Aha~... I guess it'd be a little cramped, though~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}も一緒に寝る～？
あは～、
さすがにせまいかな～♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And so Kaori spent the remaining days before her departure for her hometown happily together with {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
故郷へ出発するまでの残りの日々を、
{0}と楽しく過ごすカオリであった。
